label: Naive CD8 T cells
description: Cluster 0 is dominated by M69, a naive T cell program (TCF7, LEF1, CCR7, SELL, IL7R, LTB, SATB1, CD8A, CD8B) with 17% of counts in 98% of cells and 63x fold enrichment, and the top genes (CD8A, TCF7, LEF1, CCR7, SATB1, THEMIS, KLRK1) match. Supporting T identity comes from M32 and M61 (pan-T markers CD3E, CD3D, TRAC, CD2). Cytotoxic genes sit outside this cluster's main metagenes, so the call is naive CD8 T cells. Remaining mass is diffuse housekeeping background (M0, M24) and mitochondrial (M12), with no meaningful foreign lineage signal.
cell_types: Naive CD8 T cells, Naive T cells
metagene_label: Naive CD8 T cell markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Naive T cells (CD4-leaning)
description: Cluster 1 is a naive T-cell population. Its largest metagenes are pan-T and naive-T factors (M64, M52, M61, M42, M75, M56), and the top genes are TRBC1, TRAC, TCF7, CCR7, LEF1, SATB1 and BCL11B. M66 and M79 add a naive CD4-like component (IL7R, SELL, CCR7, CD4), so CD4 naive cells are likely a major part of it, but CD8 naive cells are not excluded. Cytotoxic and B-cell markers are absent, and the diffuse background factors (M0, M24, M78, M83) are unassigned and carry no lineage signal.
cell_types: Naive CD4 T cells, Naive T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + Naive T cell markers

label: Naive T cells (CD4-leaning)
description: Cluster of quiescent naive T cells. The lineage metagenes M52 (naive T markers, TCF7/LEF1/CCR7/SELL/LTB) and M66 (naive CD4-type, IL7R/LEF1/CCR7/SELL/CD4) carry most of the identity signal, supported by M64, M56 and the pan-T factor M61. The top genes (TCF7, IL7R, LEF1, CCR7, SATB1, BCL11B, TRAT1) agree. Cytotoxic CD8 and NK markers are absent, so the cells lean CD4 but the CD4/CD8 split is not sharp. Background factors (M0, M24) and the glucocorticoid program M9 do not indicate a foreign lineage, so no contamination is called.
cell_types: Naive CD4 T cells, Naive T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + Naive T cell markers

label: Naive T cells (CD4-leaning)
description: Cluster of quiescent naive T cells. Several T-lineage metagenes carry the signal: M52 (naive T markers, TCF7/LEF1/CCR7/SELL/LTB/IL7R) and M66 (naive CD4 program with IL7R, CD4, TRAT1, ITK) lead, supported by M64, M56 and M79. Top genes TCF7, LEF1, CCR7, BCL11B, SATB1, ITPKB and MAL confirm the naive T identity. Cytotoxic (GZMK, NKG7, CD8A) and B-cell markers are absent. Diffuse background factors (M0, M24, M23, M68) and an immediate-early stress program (M21) make up the remainder, with no foreign lineage signal. CD4 versus CD8 is only partly resolved, so the label stays at the naive T level.
cell_types: Naive T cells, Naive CD4 T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + Naive T cell markers
refine_reason: Composition matches clusters 1 and 2 (naive CD4 metagene M66 is a leading factor), so it should carry the same CD4-leaning qualifier.

label: Naive T cells (interferon-high)
description: Cluster of naive T cells (T-lineage and naive-state metagenes M66, M64, M52, M56, M75 together account for roughly 20% of counts; M66 is CD4-leaning) with a strong type I interferon-stimulated program (M57, 3.9% share, 11.6x fold; IFI44, IFI6, OAS3, MX1, ISG15) and a secondary IFN-gamma signal (M99). Top genes TCF7, LEF1, CCR7 support naive T identity, and ISGs dominate the enriched genes. Diffuse background metagenes (M0, M20, M24) are not lineage-informative. No clear contaminating lineage.
cell_types: Naive CD4 T cells, Naive T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + Naive CD4 T cells

label: Class-switched memory B cells
description: Cluster 5 is B lineage, dominated by M50 (class-switched memory B cells, 20.2% share, present in 91% of cells) with supporting naive-core M2 (9.4%, fold 4.9x) and add-on B-state M53 (FCRL5/IGHG3-high). Top genes MS4A1, CD79A/B, BANK1, BLK, TNFRSF13B/C, POU2AF1, IGHA1, IGHG1, IGKC and JCHAIN confirm B identity with a class-switched/memory tilt, with some plasmablast-like signal. No meaningful foreign lineage; remaining metagenes are diffuse background or stress programs.
cell_types: Memory B cells, Class-switched B cells, Naive B cells
metagene_label: Class-switched memory B cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Naive B cells
description: Cluster 6 is a large naive B cell population: M2 (Naive B cell markers) carries 30.4% of counts in all cells at 59x fold, and top genes IGHM, IGHD, MS4A1, CD79A, PAX5, TCL1A, FCER2, FCRL1, CD22 and BANK1 are strongly enriched. M4 (naive/quiescence program, CXCR4/SELL/KLF2) adds 11.6% in 67% of cells but lacks lineage markers and is a shared quiescence signal, not a T cell identity. Stress/IEG and glucocorticoid programs (M25, M9, M22, M6) are minor. No meaningful foreign lineage signal is present; M53 (B add-on, class-switched) is negligible and mostly enriched in cluster 7.
cell_types: Naive B cells
metagene_label: Naive B cell markers + Naive lymphocyte quiescence program

label: Class-switched memory B cells, FCRL5/IGHG3-high
description: Cluster 7 is a B-lineage population: M53 (B cell add-on, FCRL5/IGHG3-high, 31% share, in nearly all cells) and M2 (naive B cell markers, 9.9%) are the main metagenes, with M50 (class-switched memory B, 3.8%) adding a switched/memory tilt. Top genes MS4A1, CD79A, CD72, FCRL5, FCRL3, CD22, BANK1 and IGHD/IGHM support B identity, and there is no meaningful T/NK or myeloid foreign signal. The cluster leans toward class-switched/memory B cells (IGHG3, IGHG1, FCRL5) rather than naive, with immediate-early/stress genes (JUND, RHOB, KLF2 in M53) as a handling signature. Diffuse background metagenes (M0, M20, M58, M38) are low specificity and not treated as contamination.
cell_types: Memory B cells, Naive B cells
metagene_label: B cell add-on, FCRL5/IGHG3-high + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background
refine_reason: Same identity as cluster 5 (class-switched memory B cells). The dominant FCRL5/IGHG3 add-on state (M53, 31%) is a clear difference, so it is stated as a qualifier.

label: Classical monocytes (immediate-early high)
description: Cluster 8 is a classical monocyte population. M1 (classical monocyte markers, 25.7% share, 73% of cells, fold 18x) and M5 (classical monocytes with immediate-early/activation component, 15.6%, fold 53x) carry the identity, supported by top genes S100A9, LYZ, S100A8, VCAN, CD14, CSF3R, KLF4 and SPI1. M46 (monocyte/macrophage, 9.1%) adds a myeloid core, and M77 (CLEC10A-high DC, 4.4% in 11% of cells) suggests a minor DC-like or monocyte-DC mixed subset. Substantial immediate-early/stress signal (M5, M41, M21, M27, M55) reflects dissociation or activation and is not lineage. No clear foreign lineage contamination.
cell_types: Classical monocytes, Monocytes
metagene_label: Classical monocyte markers + Classical monocytes, immediate early-high

label: Classical monocytes (some DC mixing)
description: Cluster 9 is a classical monocyte population: M1 (classical monocyte markers, S100A9, LYZ, S100A8, VCAN, CD14) carries 31% of counts in 87% of cells at 11x enrichment, and M46 (monocyte/macrophage core: LYZ, CTSS, CD14, SPI1, MPEG1, CYBB) adds 13% in 58% of cells. The top genes (LYZ, S100A9, S100A8, VCAN, CD14, CST3, FGL2) confirm the myeloid identity. M77 (CLEC10A-high DC, 9%) is present in 38% of cells and peaks in cluster 10, suggesting some DC-monocyte doublet or mixing signal, but it is a minority of the cluster. M8 (non-classical FCGR3A/CDKN1C, 2.8%) is minor. Diffuse background factors (M0, M7, M15, M40, M28, M13) and the interferon program M57 are low and non-lineage-specific.
cell_types: Classical monocytes, Monocytes
contaminants: Dendritic cells (CLEC10A-high, M77, 9% share, partial doublet or mixing signal)
metagene_label: Classical monocyte markers + Monocyte/macrophage markers

label: Dendritic cells (cDC2-like)
description: Cluster 10 is a small dendritic cell population. M77 (Dendritic cells, CLEC10A-high) holds 40.9% of counts and is present in 99.4% of cells, with 49x fold enrichment. The top genes CLEC10A (48.7x), FCER1A, CD1D, CIITA and CD74 support a cDC2-like identity. Monocyte genes (LYZ, CST3, FGL2) are shared with M77 and M1 is only 2.8% (7.3% of cells), so there is no clear monocyte contamination. CD1C is weak here, so the cDC2 subtype call is moderate. pDC (M16, 1.8%) and progenitor (M85, 0.7%) signals are negligible.
cell_types: Dendritic cells (cDC2-like), Dendritic cells, Monocytes
metagene_label: Dendritic cells, CLEC10A-high + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Activated classical monocytes
description: Cluster 11 is a monocyte population, led by the classical monocyte metagene M1 (21.9% share, S100A9, LYZ, S100A8, VCAN, CD14) with support from the monocyte/macrophage factor M46 and the classical immediate-early-high factor M5. It is strongly activated: M98 (17.7% share, in 90.7% of cells) carries NFKBIA, CXCL8, IL1B, CCL3 and TNF, and the top genes CXCL8, IL1B and G0S2 are enriched about 75-fold. A small DC signal (M77, 3.6%) and immediate-early programs are minor and do not change the identity.
cell_types: Classical monocytes, Monocytes
metagene_label: Classical monocyte markers + Activated myeloid inflammatory response

label: Non-classical monocytes (CD16+)
description: Cluster 12 is dominated by M8 (43.8% of counts, present in essentially all cells), a CD16+ non-classical monocyte signature. The top genes agree: FCGR3A, MS4A7, LST1, CSF1R, LILRB2 and AIF1 are all enriched over other cells, while CD14 and VCAN are not among the top genes. M46 (3.3%) and M5 (1.9%) add classical myeloid signal, consistent with a monocyte lineage that leans non-classical. M77 (DC, 1.8%) and the diffuse background M7 (9%) are minor and do not change the identity. No clear foreign lineage is present.
cell_types: Non-classical monocytes, Monocytes
metagene_label: Non-classical monocytes (FCGR3A/CDKN1C) + ACTB/VIM/TMSB4X-high

label: CD4 T cells (naive/central memory-like)
description: Cluster 13 is a CD4 T-cell cluster, led by M14 (CD4 T cell markers, 7.5% share, 13.5x fold, present in 32% of cells) with supporting T-lineage metagenes M59, M61, M30 and M79. Top genes IL7R, LTB, TRAC, CD5, CCR4, CD28, GATA3 and CD4 support helper T cells with a naive/central-memory-leaning profile. Large diffuse background metagenes (M0, M20, M13) and stress program M49 carry modest shares without lineage meaning. No strong foreign lineage signal is present.
cell_types: CD4 T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + CD4 T cell markers

label: CD4 T cells (memory-like)
description: Cluster of CD4 T cells, memory-like with a naive/central-memory-leaning profile. The lineage rests on M14 (CD4 T-cell markers: IL7R, LTB, CD3E, CD4, TCF7, GATA3, CD40LG) and M10 (broad T-cell markers: IL32, CD2, CD5, CD6, THEMIS, TRAC), supported by the top genes IL7R, IL32, CD5, CD6, MAF, GATA3, CD40LG and TNFRSF25. M86 adds a CD4 CTLA4/CD28-high state at low share. Signal is diffuse, with the largest share going to background M0 (7.8%). M29 (MAIT-like, 3.0%) and immediate-early programs (M17, M6, M49) are minor and do not change the identity. No clear foreign lineage contamination.
cell_types: CD4 T cells, Memory T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + CD4 T cell markers

label: GZMK-high CD8 effector memory T cells
description: Cluster of T lineage cells. The dominant identity signal is M48 (5.8% share, fold 11.2x, in 14.7% of cells), a GZMK-high CD8 effector-memory program, supported by top genes CCL5, GZMK, TRBC2, TRBC1 and CD8A/GZMA. Pan-T metagenes M61 and M59 and the naive-leaning M56 add lineage support, and CD4-leaning M86 and M30 are present at lower share, so the cluster may include CD4 memory cells. Diffuse background metagenes (M0, M11, M58, M45) are unannotated and do not define identity. No clear foreign lineage contamination is listed.
cell_types: CD8 effector memory T cells, T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + GZMK-high CD8 effector memory T cells

label: Regulatory T cells (FOXP3/IL2RA)
description: Cluster 16 is dominated by a regulatory T cell signature: M39 (FOXP3, IL2RA, CTLA4, TIGIT, IKZF2, RTKN2) holds 11.7% of counts at 59.7x fold and is present in 55% of cells, with top genes FOXP3, RTKN2, CTLA4, IL2RA and TIGIT strongly enriched. Supporting pan-T lineage metagenes (M30 CD4 memory, M86 CD4 state, M59, M19, M42) are present at modest shares, consistent with CD4 T cells. Diffuse background metagenes (M0, M11, M7, M45, M60) are ambiguous and not lineage-specific, and no clear foreign lineage contamination is present.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells
metagene_label: Regulatory T cells (FOXP3/IL2RA) + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Cytotoxic NK cells (CD56dim CD16+)
description: Cluster 17 is dominated by M3 (33.4% of counts, present in all cells, 20x fold), a cytotoxic lymphocyte program with GNLY, NKG7, PRF1, GZMB, FGFBP2, KLRF1, SH2D1B, KLRD1 and FCGR3A, consistent with CD56dim/CD16-high cytotoxic NK cells. Top genes confirm this (GNLY, PRF1, NKG7, FGFBP2, SPON2, GZMB, KLRF1, KLRD1, FCGR3A) with some CD247 and TRDC, which fit NKT-like or CD8 effector overlap. Remaining metagenes are diffuse housekeeping, ribosomal or mitochondrial background, and the cell-cycle program M93 is minor, so no contamination call is made.
cell_types: Cytotoxic NK cells, NKT-like cells, CD8 effector T cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic NK cell markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Cytotoxic NK cells (CD56dim CD16+)
description: Cluster 18 is dominated by a cytotoxic NK program: M3 (23.2% share, 92% of cells, 6.8x fold) carries GNLY, NKG7, PRF1, GZMB, FGFBP2, KLRF1 and SH2D1B, and M34 (8.4%, 13.8x fold) adds IL2RB, CTSW, KLRD1 and NCAM1. Top genes (GNLY, NKG7, PRF1, IL2RB, CTSW, KLRD1, KLRF1, IL18RAP) confirm an NK identity, with some T-lineage overlap (TRDC, CD247, CD8-like M74 at 2.1%) that is best read as NK-like or gamma-delta-adjacent cytotoxic lymphocytes. Remaining metagenes are diffuse background (M0, M90, M37 and others, each under 11%) with no evidence of a second lineage.
cell_types: Cytotoxic NK cells, NK-like T cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic NK cell markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background
refine_reason: Same identity as cluster 17 (CD56dim CD16+ cytotoxic NK cells, shared M3 program), so the wording should match.

label: NK cells (some NK-like T cells)
description: Cluster 19 is an NK cell cluster. M34 (NK cell markers) carries 30% of counts and is present in 98% of cells, with 51x fold enrichment. Top genes GNLY, IL2RB, KLRC1, NCAM1, KLRF1, KLRD1 and CTSW support NK identity, and M3 (cytotoxic NK markers) adds a smaller cytotoxic NK signal. Some TRDC, CD7 and SELL signal suggests NK-like T or gamma-delta T cells in a minority. No meaningful foreign lineage contamination; M85 (CD34 progenitors, 1.6%) and the diffuse background metagenes are negligible.
cell_types: NK cells, Gamma-delta T cells
metagene_label: NK cell markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Cytotoxic NK cells (some CD8 effector T overlap)
description: Cytotoxic lymphocytes dominated by M3 (16.4% of counts, present in 81% of cells), whose genes (GNLY, NKG7, PRF1, GZMB, FGFBP2, KLRF1, SH2D1B) point to NK cells. Top genes NKG7, GNLY, PRF1, FGFBP2, GZMH, SPON2 and KLRD1 fit this, with no strong CD3/CD8 T-cell signal among them. M26 (13.4%, shared cytotoxic effector axis with CD8A) and M74 (2.5%, CD8 effector program in 6.6% of cells) indicate some overlap with terminal effector CD8 T cells. Foreign lineage signal is negligible; the stromal/PTGDS-like M43 is only 2.4%.
cell_types: NK cells, CD8 effector T cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic NK cell markers + Cytotoxic effector T/NK cells

label: Effector CD8 T cells (NK-like overlap)
description: Cluster 21 is dominated by cytotoxic CD8 effector T cells. M74 (CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells) has 16.6x fold enrichment and is present in 63% of cells, with top genes CD8A (5.7x), KLRG1, EOMES, CTSW and NKG7. M26 (cytotoxic effector T/NK) adds a shared cytotoxic axis (NKG7, GNLY, CCL5, GZMH) in 68% of cells, and M3 (NK markers) is only 4.8% of counts at 1.1x fold, so it reflects NK-like overlap rather than a distinct NK population. No foreign lineage contamination is supported.
cell_types: CD8 T cells, NK cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic effector T/NK cells + CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells

label: Cytotoxic effector CD8 T/NK cells
description: Cluster of cytotoxic lymphocytes present in nearly all cells. The main signal is M26 (19.5% share, 16x fold), with NKG7, CCL5, GNLY, GZMH, PRF1, CST7, KLRK1 and KLRD1 among the top genes, plus FGFBP2 and ADGRG1 suggesting terminal effector differentiation. M74 adds a CD8 effector signal (CD8A, EOMES, KLRG1, CTSW), and CD8A is among the most enriched genes (5.8x). CD3E is weak, so T and NK identity cannot be fully separated, though CD8A and EOMES favor CD8 effector T cells. Minor T-cell metagenes (M10, M32, M94) and diffuse background metagenes (M0, M11, M37, M76) add little. No meaningful foreign lineage is present.
cell_types: CD8 effector T cells, NK cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic effector T/NK cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: GZMK-high CD8 effector memory T cells
description: Cluster 23 is dominated by CD8 T-cell signal: M74 (cytotoxic CD8 effector/effector-memory program, NKG7, CTSW, CD8A, EOMES, KLRK1, KLRG1; 6.5% share, 8.6x fold) and M48 (GZMK-high CD8 effector memory, CCL5, GZMK, CD8A, GZMA, EOMES, CD3E; 6.4% share, 20.5x fold) are the most enriched metagenes, with top genes CCL5, GZMK, CD8A, IL32, KLRK1, EOMES and GZMA. Terminal NK genes (GNLY, FGFBP2) sit in other metagenes, so the cluster leans toward GZMK-high CD8 memory/effector T cells. Diffuse background metagenes (M0, M23, M13, M11) make up the rest without indicating a foreign lineage.
cell_types: CD8 effector memory T cells, CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells

label: Plasmacytoid dendritic cells
description: Cluster 24 is dominated by M16 (56.1% of counts, present in all cells, >100x fold) carrying the pDC-specific genes CLEC4C, LILRA4, SERPINF1, PTPRS, IL3RA, PLD4, TCF4, JCHAIN and IRF7/IRF8; top genes confirm this (CLEC4C, PLD4, PTPRS, JCHAIN, IRF7, LILRA4, IL3RA all >30x fold). Myeloid (CD1C, CLEC10A, LYZ, CD14) markers are absent, so this is a clean plasmacytoid dendritic cell population with no meaningful foreign lineage. M85 (CD34+ progenitor, 0.9%) and the diffuse background metagenes (M0, M47, M28, M65, M63, M72, M7) are minor and do not define identity.
cell_types: Plasmacytoid dendritic cells
metagene_label: pDC markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Cytotoxic CD8 effector T cells
description: Cluster 25 is a cytotoxic lymphocyte population, most likely terminal effector CD8 T cells with some NK-like character. M26 (cytotoxic effector, 15.9% share, present in 89% of cells) carries NKG7, GNLY, CCL5, GZMH, FGFBP2 and CD8A, and the top genes include CD8A (3.5x), CD2, THEMIS, SAMD3 and IL32. T-lineage support comes from M10 (T cell markers, 8.5%) and M32. CD3E is weak, so NK and T identity cannot be fully separated. Diffuse background metagenes (M0, M11, M37, M76, M72, M13) and the immediate-early program M89 add no lineage signal and are ignored. No clear foreign lineage contamination.
cell_types: CD8 effector T cells, NK cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic effector T/NK cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: MAIT-like T cells
description: Cluster dominated by M29, an innate-like MAIT-like T cell program (12.9% of counts, in 58.7% of cells, 41.6x fold), with top genes KLRB1, RORA, IL7R, CCR5 and LTK. The MAIT identity is not fully confirmed because TRAV1-2 is not measured and ZBTB16 and CCR6 carry weak weight. Minor CD8 effector-memory signal from M48 (4.2%, 1.3% of cells) and cytotoxic M26 (4.0%) is consistent with T-cell subsets rather than contamination. Diffuse housekeeping factors (M0, M13) are ignored.
cell_types: MAIT cells, CD8 effector memory T cells, NK-like T cells
metagene_label: MAIT-like T cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Platelets/megakaryocytes
description: Cluster 27 is dominated by platelet/megakaryocyte transcripts: M31 accounts for 82% of modeled counts and is present in all cells, with PPBP, PF4, TUBB1, ITGA2B, GP1BB and CAVIN2 among the top genes at >100x fold enrichment. Other lineages are negligible (M1 classical monocyte 1.2%, M85 CD34+ progenitor 0.9%, M8 non-classical monocyte 0.5%), so there is no meaningful contamination call. Non-specific metagenes (M0, M11, M7, M12) are minor.
cell_types: Platelets, Megakaryocytes
metagene_label: Platelet/megakaryocyte genes + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: CD34+ hematopoietic progenitor cells
description: Cluster 28 is dominated by M85 (27.8% of counts, present in 52% of cells, fold >100x), a hematopoietic stem/progenitor signature. The top genes support it: CD34, SPINK2, MEX3B, HOXA9, MEIS1, GATA2, MYB, SOX4 and NREP are all strongly enriched, and lineage markers are absent. M50 (9.2%, in 26% of cells) carries B-lineage genes (MS4A1, CD79A, IGHA1, IGKC, IGHG1, JCHAIN), a moderate share that likely reflects B-cell doublets or spillover and is not the cluster's own identity. M93 (cycling) and M31 (platelet) are minor.
cell_types: CD34+ hematopoietic progenitor cells
metagene_label: CD34+ progenitor cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background
